description.value: Stong's Market is a locally owned independent grocery chain with a Squamish location stocking major brands alongside local, gourmet, and organic products across specialized departments including produce, bakery, seafood, and wellness. The chain has a strong sustainability focus, partnering with Ocean Wise for sustainable seafood and the Food Stash Foundation to reduce food waste. It is a Canadian Independent Grocer of the Year award recipient and offers online ordering with express delivery to the Squamish area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 36m; rack (6 spaces) at 89m. Total: 14 spaces.
